integrity: All finite enumerations, integral Morse boundary entries and unimodular diagonalizations are reconstructed by the included standalone Python 3 verifier and compared against the included certificate. Assertions rely only on the two explicit graph definitions and standard integer chain cancellation; no independent review is asserted.
limitations: The theorem determines integral reduced homology and equal face vectors only for the named eight-vertex cubic graphs. It does not establish homotopy wedge types, equivariant actions, or a general cubic-graph formula. Indexed literature searches cannot guarantee absence of an unindexed equivalent calculation.
title: Equal face vectors but unequal integral multipath homology for the Wagner and cube graphs
